issues.issue: The 'utilities' function means running a water/sewer/electric/gas/refuse utility. This line is the airport's own utility bills (detail_category utilities (power, gas, phone) is right), so the function should match the airport's other operating lines rather than 'utilities'. Same for detail[10].category.

All eight lines are airport operating costs, but they're split across three functions (general government for bookkeeping, insurance, office and registration; other for fuel, maintenance and the irrigation assessment; utilities for utility bills). There's no airport function, so one consistent function for the whole schedule would be more defensible. This is a judgment call.
Detail line uses function category 'other' without a review flag. The matching disbursements[4] line has one.
